title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: In one request, your assistant makes its fifth model call, after four tool results have come back. Which description of what the model receives in that call is correct?

options.text: Only the newest tool result, since the model remembers the earlier four
The instructions, the question and every earlier request and result so far
A short summary that the model wrote on its own after each step
Only the question and the newest request, to keep the call cheap

items.stem: Your assistant's instructions and tool definitions take 1,500 tokens and the student's question takes 100 tokens. The model makes a 40-token tool request, and the tool returns 500 tokens. The model makes a second 40-token tool request, and that tool returns 2,000 tokens. How many input tokens does the model read in its third call?
A student finished band saw training last week and opens a brand-new chat today. Which design lets the assistant know this, without a student having to say so?

options.text: Using a model whose context window is ten times larger than before
Telling the model in its instructions to remember every student it meets
Saving the training record outside the model and loading it into each new chat
Asking the model to keep last week's chat open as a long single call

items.stem: Your team proposes pasting all 600 pages of the machine manuals into the context of every call, instead of searching them. Give one reason this is a bad idea for the assistant.
You give the model a memory tool that has a create command. The model decides to save a note about a student. What happens next?

options.text: The model writes the file itself, directly onto your server's disk
The model's reply is stored automatically, with no program involved
The program notices the note is important and saves it unprompted
The model asks for the file to be created, and your code does it
